truefeedback.text:
Here is a worked solution:

\(\vec{OP} = {@if faceHighlight=1 then (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{OB} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{BF}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{OA} + \\vec{AE} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{EG}" else "\\vec{OA} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{AD}") else if faceHighlight=2 then (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{OA} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{AE}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{OA} + \\vec{AD} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{DG}" else "\\vec{OC} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{CF}") else (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{OB} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{BE}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{OB} + \\vec{BF} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{FG}" else "\\vec{OC} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{CD}")@}\)

\(\vec{OP} = {@if faceHighlight=1 then (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{b} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{c}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{a} + \\vec{b} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{c}" else "\\vec{a} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{c}") else if faceHighlight=2 then (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{a} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{b}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{a} + \\vec{c} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{b}" else "\\vec{c} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{b}") else (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{b} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{a}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{b} + \\vec{c} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{a}" else "\\vec{c} + \\frac{1}{2}\\vec{a}")@}\)

\(\vec{OP} = {@simp:false, if faceHighlight=1 then (if edgePoint=1 then vecB+(1/2)*vecC else if edgePoint=2 then vecA+vecB+(1/2)*vecC else vecA+(1/2)*vecC) else if faceHighlight=2 then (if edgePoint=1 then vecA+(1/2)*vecB else if edgePoint=2 then vecA+vecC+(1/2)*vecB else vecC+(1/2)*vecB) else (if edgePoint=1 then vecB+(1/2)*vecA else if edgePoint=2 then vecB+vecC+(1/2)*vecA else vecC+(1/2)*vecA)@}\)

\(\vec{OP} = {@tans1@}\)

You have found the vector to the midpoint of \({@if faceHighlight=1 then (if edgePoint=1 then "OF" else if edgePoint=2 then "OG" else "OD") else if faceHighlight=2 then (if edgePoint=1 then "OE" else if edgePoint=2 then "OG" else "OF") else (if edgePoint=1 then "OE" else if edgePoint=2 then "OG" else "OD")@}\).
However, the point \(P\) is actually the midpoint of \({@edgePointName@}\).
So, you should not have halved the vector \({@if faceHighlight=1 then (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{OB}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{OE} = \\vec{OA} + \\vec{OB}" else "\\vec{OA}") else if faceHighlight=2 then (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{OA}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{OD} = \\vec{OA} + \\vec{OC}" else "\\vec{OC}") else (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{OB}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{OF} = \\vec{OB} + \\vec{OC}" else "\\vec{OC}")@}\).

You have found the vector \({@if faceHighlight=1 then (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{BP}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{EP}" else "\\vec{AP}") else if faceHighlight=2 then (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{AP}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{DP}" else "\\vec{CP}") else (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{BP}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{FP}" else "\\vec{CP}")@}\).
However, you have forgotten to add the vector \({@if faceHighlight=1 then (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{OB}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{OE} = \\vec{OA} + \\vec{OB}" else "\\vec{OA}") else if faceHighlight=2 then (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{OA}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{OD} = \\vec{OA} + \\vec{OC}" else "\\vec{OC}") else (if edgePoint=1 then "\\vec{OB}" else if edgePoint=2 then "\\vec{OF} = \\vec{OB} + \\vec{OC}" else "\\vec{OC}")@}\).

The \({@if float(first(first(ans1)))=float(first(first(tans1))) then "x" else "y"@}\) and \({@if float(first(third(ans1)))=float(first(third(tans1))) then "z" else "y"@}\) components of your vector are correct.
However, the other component is not.

Here is a worked solution:

\(\vec{OQ} = {@if faceHighlight=1 then "\\vec{OC} + \\frac{1}{2}(\\vec{CD} + \\vec{DG})" else if faceHighlight=2 then "\\vec{OB} + \\frac{1}{2}(\\vec{BE} + \\vec{EG})" else "\\vec{OA} + \\frac{1}{2}(\\vec{AE} + \\vec{EG})"@}\)

\(\vec{OQ} = {@if faceHighlight=1 then "\\vec{c} + \\frac{1}{2}(\\vec{a} + \\vec{b})" else if faceHighlight=2 then "\\vec{b} + \\frac{1}{2}(\\vec{a} + \\vec{c})" else "\\vec{a} + \\frac{1}{2}(\\vec{b} + \\vec{c})"@}\)

\(\vec{OQ} = {@simp:false, if faceHighlight=1 then vecC + (1/2)*vecA + (1/2)*vecB else if faceHighlight=2 then vecB + (1/2)*vecA + (1/2)*vecC else vecA + (1/2)*vecB + (1/2)*vecC@}\)

\(\vec{OQ} = {@tans2@}\)

You have found the vector to the midpoint of \(OG\).
However, the point \(Q\) is actually the centre of \({@faceHighName@}\).
So, you should not have halved the vector \({@if faceHighlight=1 then "\\vec{OC}" else if faceHighlight=2 then "\\vec{OB}" else "\\vec{OA}"@}\).

You have found the vector \({@if faceHighlight=1 then "\\vec{CQ}" else if faceHighlight=2 then "\\vec{BQ}" else "\\vec{AQ}"@}\).
However, you have forgotten to add the vector \({@if faceHighlight=1 then "\\vec{OC}" else if faceHighlight=2 then "\\vec{OB}" else "\\vec{OA}"@}\) in order to find \(\vec{OQ}\).

The \({@if float(first(first(ans2)))=float(first(first(tans2))) then "x" else "y"@}\) and \({@if float(first(third(ans2)))=float(first(third(tans2))) then "z" else "y"@}\) components of your vector are correct.
However, the other component is not.

Your answer is not the correct vector \(\vec{PQ}\).
However, it is consistent which the answers that you gave to parts (a) and (b).

You have attempted to find the vector \(\vec{QP}\) rather than \(\vec{PQ}\).
Since \(\vec{PQ} = \vec{OQ} - \vec{OP}\), you should have subtracted your answer for (a) from your answer for (b).

You have summed your answers from parts (a) and (b).
However, you should have found the difference between them.
Remember \(\vec{PQ} = \vec{PO} + \vec{OQ} = -\vec{OP} + \vec{OQ}\).
